name: gitops-nav
description: Navigate a gitops repo, its chart repos, pipelines and datasets from one window.

commands.title: Go to App, Pipeline or Dataset…

gitopsNav.root.description: Folder that holds all the repos side by side. Empty = the first workspace folder.

gitopsNav.gitopsRepo.description: Folder name of the gitops repo (laid out as <namespace>/<app>/cicd.yaml).

gitopsNav.repoKey.markdownDescription: Key in each gitops app's `cicd.yaml` / `ci.yaml` that holds the component repo's `.git` URL. Use a dotted path for a nested key, e.g. `source.repo`.

path.description: Folder inside the repo to search, e.g. `jobs`. Empty = the whole repo.

gitopsNav.pipelineRepos.description: Repos to search for files named `pipeline`, optionally limited to a folder inside each.

gitopsNav.databaseRepo.description: Folder name of the database repo.

gitopsNav.datasetPattern.markdownDescription: Where dataset files are in the database repo, relative to its root. Placeholders: `${dataset}` (any name), `${dataset_upper}` (an all-uppercase name, shown lowercased), `${dataset_lower}` (an all-lowercase name); `*` matches anything within one folder or file name. Examples: `datasets/${dataset}/structure.sql`, `some/folder/${dataset_upper}_blah.sql`.

gitopsNav.gitopsBranch.markdownDescription: Branch the gitops repo should normally be on. A warning shows in the status bar when it isn't. Empty = no warning.

enumDescriptions: Show the link bar at the top of files and make values clickable.
Only the link bar at the top of files.

gitopsNav.componentIcon.description: Icon for component repos in search and the link bar.

gitopsNav.gitopsTint.markdownDescription: Tint the gitops folder and the folders under it in the explorer (files are left alone), so it stands out subtly in any theme. Change the exact colours with `workbench.colorCustomizations`.

enumDescriptions: Open the first file from `gitopsNav.componentOpenOrder` that exists.
Just show the repo folder in the explorer, ignoring `gitopsNav.componentOpenOrder`.
gitopsNav.componentOpenMode.markdownDescription: What jumping to a component repo does.

gitopsNav.componentOpenOrder.markdownDescription: Files to open when jumping to a component repo, in priority order: the first one that exists is opened. Paths are relative to the repo root; `${chart}` is the folder holding `Chart.yaml`. If none exist, the repo folder is shown in the explorer.

gitopsNav.bitbucketUrl.description: Web address of Bitbucket, e.g. https://bitbucket.invalid. Empty = https://<host of the git remote>.

gitopsNav.defaultBranches.description: Branch for Bitbucket links when your checked-out branch isn't on the remote, by repo folder name. Repos not listed use Bitbucket's default branch.

gitopsNav.argoCdUrl.markdownDescription: Argo CD page for an app, shown as an "Argo CD" link at the top of its gitops files. Placeholders (URL-encoded): `${name}` = the app's folder name in gitops, `${namespace}` = its namespace, `${repoName}` = the component repo, from the end of its `repo:` URL. Empty = no link.

gitopsNav.argoCdDevUrl.markdownDescription: Argo CD page linked from `values-dev.yaml` (the dev chart, deployed to `<namespace>-dev`), shown as "Argo CD (dev)". Same placeholders as `#gitopsNav.argoCdUrl#`: `${name}`, `${namespace}` (the gitops namespace, so write `${namespace}-dev` for the dev one), `${repoName}`. Empty = use `#gitopsNav.argoCdUrl#`.

gitopsNav.argoCdCiUrl.markdownDescription: Argo CD page linked from `values-ci.yaml` (the CI chart that lays down the Tekton pipeline), shown as "Argo CD (CI)". Same placeholders as `#gitopsNav.argoCdUrl#`: `${name}`, `${namespace}`, `${repoName}`. Empty = use `#gitopsNav.argoCdUrl#`.

gitopsNav.pipelineDashboardUrl.markdownDescription: Web page for a pipeline, shown as a "pipeline" link at the top of each `pipeline` file. Placeholders (URL-encoded): `${name}` = the pipeline's `name:`, `${repoName}` = the repo holding the pipeline. Empty = no link.

colors.description: Text colour for gitops files when gitopsNav.gitopsTint is "accent".
Text colour for gitops files when gitopsNav.gitopsTint is "muted".
